knn.rationale: Instance-based cosine-distance model using the exact candidate grid from the reference project.
knn.representation: cleaner + character/word TF-IDF FeatureUnion + Chi-square top-50 fitted inside each CV fold

decision_tree.rationale: Nonlinear decision-tree baseline with depth selected by group-aware validation Macro F1.
decision_tree.representation: cleaner + character/word TF-IDF FeatureUnion + Chi-square top-50 fitted inside each CV fold

logistic_regression.rationale: Balanced regularized linear classifier for the selected character and word features.
logistic_regression.representation: cleaner + character/word TF-IDF FeatureUnion + Chi-square top-50 fitted inside each CV fold

multinomial_nb.rationale: Generative non-negative feature baseline using the reference alpha grid.
multinomial_nb.representation: cleaner + character/word TF-IDF FeatureUnion + Chi-square top-50 fitted inside each CV fold
